items.body:
高市抵达菲律宾 将出席东盟会议

日本首相高市早苗为出席东盟（ASEAN）相关首脑会议，16日乘坐政府专机抵达菲律宾马尼拉。日美澳印“四边机制”（Quad）首脑会议也将举行。着眼于美中俄三国首脑会谈，日方还将摸索高市与美国总统特朗普进行个别对话。高市之后将前往中国深圳，出席亚太经合组织（APEC）首脑会议。

高市启程前在公邸接受媒体采访。她就东盟相关首脑会议强调：“希望进一步与作为‘自由开放的印度太平洋’关键的东盟加强合作。”关于APEC，她表示将就贸易、投资、提升能源韧性、人工智能（AI）等课题进行磋商，“有力地阐述日本的立场”。

在马尼拉期间，高市17日将出席日本与东盟首脑会议、日中韩与东盟首脑会议以及东亚峰会（EAS）。为实现“自由开放的印太”，她有意在能源安全及应对高性能AI等问题上与参会国家开展合作。

高市17日下午将与韩国总统李在明会谈，还将分别与菲律宾总统马科斯、泰国总理阿努廷进行会谈。

高市18日起将造访深圳。由于日中关系恶化，与中国国家主席习近平进行正式会谈的形势较为困难，高市将寻求对话机会。是否会与俄罗斯总统普京接触也是外界关注的焦点。她将于19日下午举行面向国内外媒体的记者会，之后回国。

items.body:
袁莉2026年11月16日

台北临江夜市。

When the news broke in Taiwan on Thursday night that Jensen Huang had resigned as Nvidia’s chief executive, Ray Wang was too upset to sleep. He drank a whole bottle of red wine and prayed for Mr. Huang.

周四晚间，黄仁勋辞去英伟达首席执行官职务的消息传到台湾时，王永泰难过得睡不着。他喝了整整一瓶红酒，还为黄仁勋祈祷。

A hairstylist, Mr. Wang, has been cutting Mr. Huang’s hair, watching it change from salt-and-pepper to silver, for nearly a decade.

王永泰是一名发型师，近十年来一直为黄仁勋剪头发，看着他的头发从花白变成银灰。

“Maybe they’ll bring him back,” Mr. Wang said, “the way Apple brought back Steve Jobs.”

“也许他们会请他回来，”王永泰说，“就像苹果当年请回史蒂夫·乔布斯一样。”

Mr. Huang has many well-wishers like this in Taiwan. An American citizen, he moved to the United States when he was 9 years old, but he was born on the island and enjoys a godlike status there. Fans mobbed him at night markets and lined up for autographs. Restaurants where he has eaten hang his photo, Hollywood-celebrity style. He has been hailed as the “pride of Taiwan” and affectionately called “the people’s dad.” The frenzy around his visits became known as “Jensanity,” a play on the “Linsanity” that followed Jeremy Lin, the Taiwanese-American professional basketball player.

在台湾，像王永泰这样关心黄仁勋的人还有很多。黄仁勋是美国公民，九岁时移居美国，但他出生在台湾，在当地享有近乎神一般的地位。粉丝在夜市围住他，排队索要签名。他光顾过的餐厅像展示好莱坞明星一样挂出他的照片。他被誉为“台湾之光”，还被亲切地称为“国民爸爸”。人们甚至仿照当年台裔美国职业篮球运动员林书豪引发的“林来疯”(Linsanity)热潮，创造出“仁来疯”(Jensanity)一词来形容这种现象。

Mr. Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993, and it became one of the world’s most valuable companies in recent years by making advanced chips for artificial intelligence. Over the decades, Mr. Huang made Nvidia’s relationship with Taiwan personal.

黄仁勋于1993年与他人共同创办英伟达，近年来，英伟达凭借生产用于人工智能的先进芯片成为全球最有价值的公司之一。几十年来，黄仁勋把英伟达与台湾的商业关系经营成了一种个人情谊。

Taiwan is home to TSMC, the premier semiconductor chip maker that produces roughly 90 percent of the world’s most advanced chips and is the main reason Taiwan’s economy is projected to grow around 12 percent this year. It is Taiwan’s most important company, and Nvidia is TSMC’s biggest customer.

台湾是台积电的所在地。台积电是首屈一指的半导体芯片制造商，生产全球约90%的最先进芯片，也是台湾今年经济预计增长约12%的主要原因。台积电是台湾最重要的企业，英伟达则是它最大的客户。

台北为黄仁勋理发的台北发型师王永泰。

在自己的发廊里，王永泰放着一本有黄仁勋签名的传记，以及这位英伟达创始人写给他的留言。

黄仁勋送给王永泰的春节红包。

Mr. Huang’s resignation followed reports of affairs, one with an Nvidia executive and another with a businesswoman, Alice Huang, whom U.S. intelligence officials suspected of providing intelligence for China. Beijing has denied the allegation.

黄仁勋辞职之前，媒体接连曝光了他的婚外情，其中一段涉及英伟达的一名高管，另一段则涉及商界女性黄乐(Alice Huang)。美国情报官员怀疑黄乐为中国提供情报。北京方面否认了这一指控。

His downfall landed with dismay and disbelief in Taiwan, where he had effectively cultivated relationships. Mr. Huang knew the people who made his chips and servers, and he made a point of crediting them in public.

黄仁勋的失势令台湾民众感到震惊和难以置信。他一直在台湾用心经营人脉。他熟悉那些为英伟达生产芯片和服务器的人，也总是特意在公开场合肯定他们的贡献。

He went to great lengths to show his appreciation for business partners — and get what he wanted. Last November, when he needed TSMC to allocate more production capacity to Nvidia, he flew to Taiwan and sat down for hot pot with its senior executives, Liang-Rong Chen, a tech journalist who was there, told me. He patiently signed whiskey bottles for its employees.

他不遗余力地表达对商业伙伴的赏识，并借此争取自己想要的东西。台湾的科技记者陈良榕告诉我，去年11月，当黄仁勋需要台积电为英伟达提供更多产能时，他飞往台湾，与台积电高管一起吃火锅。他还耐心地为台积电员工在威士忌酒瓶上签名。

Mr. Chen explained why that mattered. Squeezing more chips out of a busy factory took many managers willing to rearrange production and staff willing to work overtime. Mr. Chen, who writes the newsletter Tech Taiwan, suspected they would not have been as eager to do it for other American tech giants because none of them had gone to the great lengths as Mr. Huang in cultivating relationships.

撰写科技电子报《胡说科技》的陈良榕解释了这些举动为什么重要。让已经满负荷运转的工厂生产更多芯片需要许多管理人员愿意重新安排生产计划，也需要员工愿意加班。他认为，如果换成其他美国科技巨头，台积电的员工未必会如此积极地配合，因为没有哪家公司像黄仁勋那样，在培养关系上投入如此多的心力。

台北临江夜市一家香肠摊挂着摊主与黄仁勋的合影。

黄仁勋光顾过的餐馆会像展示好莱坞明星一样挂出他的照片和签名。

台北富霸王餐厅展示着黄仁勋签名的盘子和留言。

A longtime semiconductor analyst, who was not authorized to speak publicly, told me that without Nvidia there would be no A.I. as we see it today. Suppliers have grown accustomed to taking their cues from Mr. Huang, he said, who had a sense of where the technology was headed and was able to persuade the companies to go along with him despite the risks at times. With him gone, the analyst wondered whose judgment they would trust.

一名长期研究半导体行业的分析师告诉我，没有英伟达，就不会有我们今天所看到的人工智能。由于未经授权公开发言，这名分析师要求匿名。他说，供应商们已经习惯了听从黄仁勋的指引。黄仁勋对技术的发展方向有着敏锐的判断，即使有时需要承担风险，也能说服这些公司跟随他的步伐。如今黄仁勋离开了，这名分析师不禁要问，今后他们还会信任谁的判断。

“We hope things won’t change too much because he understands Taiwan better than anyone.” Chin-Tsang Ho, Taiwan’s deputy minister of economic affairs, told me just hours before Mr. Huang stepped down.

“我们希望事情不要发生太大变化，因为没有人比他更了解台湾，”就在黄仁勋辞职前几小时，台湾经济部次长何晋沧告诉我。

Four days before Mr. Huang’s resignation, TSMC was arranging a call with Mr. Huang to discuss plans for the next few years, said Chun-Hsien Yeh, who heads Taiwan’s National Development Council and sits on TSMC’s board. Mr. Yeh told me he expected Mr. Huang’s resignation would have little impact on TSMC, however. Demand for A.I. chips was already exceeding supply, and other customers, including AMD, needed them, too. “If Nvidia takes less,” he said. “others will take more.”

台湾国家发展委员会主委、台积电董事叶俊显说，黄仁勋辞职四天前，台积电还正安排与黄仁勋通话，讨论未来几年的计划。不过，他告诉我，预计黄仁勋的辞职不会对台积电产生太大影响。人工智能芯片的需求已经超过供应，包括AMD在内的其他客户也需要这些芯片。“如果英伟达拿得少了，”他说，“其他公司就会拿得更多。”

Quite a few people I talked to, including semiconductor insiders, said they believed that Mr. Huang didn’t deserve the treatment. “We felt the process didn’t seem quite fair,” Da-Xiang Hu, a tech professional in Taipei, told me. “We felt it all happened too fast.”

我采访的许多人，包括半导体行业内部人士，都认为黄仁勋不应该受到这样的对待。“我们觉得整个过程似乎不太公平，”台北科技业从业者胡大湘（音）告诉我。“我们觉得一切发生得太快了。”

A few even saw his downfall in conspiratorial terms, imagining that other American business and political leaders grew wary of the growing influence of tech executives of Taiwanese and Chinese descent and worked to push Mr. Huang out.

少数人甚至从阴谋论角度看待他的失势，猜测其他美国商界和政界领袖对台湾和华裔科技高管日益增长的影响力感到警惕，因此设法将黄仁勋排挤出局。

台北临江夜市的“阿婆水果”。

台北花娘小馆展示的一块有黄仁勋签名的英伟达显卡。

Other people were annoyed that their Nvidia shares fell. In a place where many people own shares in TSMC, social media quickly filled with joking anxieties about the fate of that company. On Threads, one user posted a photo of TSMC’s chief executive, Che-Chia Wei, captioning it, “Please don’t have an affair. Please. Please.” A commenter responded, “If you do have an affair, please don’t choose a Chinese spy. Please ” Both the post and the comment were liked tens of thousands of times.

另一些人则因英伟达股价下跌而恼火。在台湾，许多人持有台积电股票，社交媒体上很快出现了很多对这家公司的命运带有调侃意味的担忧。在Threads上，一名用户发布了台积电董事长魏哲家的照片，配文写道：“拜托不要有婚外情。拜托，拜托。”一名网友回复：“如果你真的要搞婚外情，拜托千万不要找中国间谍。拜托。”这条帖子和评论都获得了数万次点赞。

Many Taiwanese commentators and social media users are supportive of Mr. Huang. They thanked him for bringing business to the island and for shining a spotlight on its companies.

许多台湾评论人士和社交媒体用户支持黄仁勋。他们感谢他为台湾带来生意，并让台湾公司受到关注。

Emmy Hu, a financial content creator, wrote on Facebook that other tech giants had squeezed Taiwanese suppliers on price. “His generosity toward Taiwan was unusual,” she wrote of Mr. Huang. Yu Ting-hao, a financial commentator, called Mr. Huang “Taiwan’s biggest advocate” on his YouTube program. Kang Wen-teng, who runs a hot pot restaurant in Taichung City, told me he wanted people to remember what Mr. Huang had done for Taiwan. “Thank you, Papa Huang,” he wrote on Threads.

财经内容创作者胡采苹在Facebook上写道，其他科技巨头曾在价格上压榨台湾供应商。“他对台湾的慷慨非同寻常，”她这样评价黄仁勋。财经评论员游庭皓在自己的YouTube节目中称黄仁勋是“台湾的最大代言人”。台中市一家火锅店老板康文腾（音）告诉我，他希望人们记住黄仁勋为台湾所做的一切。“谢谢你，黄爸，”他在Threads上写道。

Still, the accusations that Mr. Huang had an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese intelligence asset troubled even his fans. Da-Xiang Hu, the tech professional in Taipei, told me how moved she was whenever Mr. Huang spoke about Taiwan abroad. After decades of Chinese pressure that has kept Taiwan isolated internationally, hearing him say “Taiwan” mattered to her. At the same time, she said, she feels uneasy about Mr. Huang’s public push to sell advanced chips to China. In a Threads post in which she thanked him, Ms. Hu wondered whether Nvidia’s chips might someday help a Chinese missile strike Taiwan more precisely. “I wish you well,” she wrote, “and I hope Taiwan stays safe.”

不过，即使是黄仁勋的支持者，也对他被指与一名涉嫌为中国情报机构提供情报的女性发生婚外情感到不安。台北科技业从业者胡大湘告诉我，每当黄仁勋在海外谈起台湾时，她都很感动。几十年来，中国的施压使台湾在国际上遭到孤立，因此，听到黄仁勋公开说出“台湾”二字，对她有着特殊的意义。但与此同时，黄仁勋公开推动向中国出售先进芯片也让她感到不安。在Threads上一则感谢黄仁勋的帖子中，胡大湘担心，英伟达的芯片有朝一日是否可能帮助中国的导弹更精确地打击台湾。“祝你一切顺利，”她写道，“也希望台湾平安。”

台北临江夜市冰世界甜品店的店主。

黄仁勋每次到访台湾都会掀起一股狂热，人们将这种现象称为“仁来疯”。

In Taiwan, there is even chatter that maybe Mr. Huang could come back and become the chief executive or a board member of TSMC.

在台湾，甚至有人开始议论，也许黄仁勋可以回来，出任台积电首席执行官或董事会成员。

To Mr. Wang, the hairstylist, Mr. Huang was both a visionary entrepreneur and an old friend. He was planning to write to him. “If he comes back to Taiwan,” he said, “I’m sure he’d come in for a haircut.”

在发型师王永泰看来，黄仁勋既是一位富有远见的企业家，也是一位老朋友。他正打算给黄仁勋写信。“如果他回到台湾，”他说，“我相信他一定还会来找我剪头发。”

他不遗余力地表达对商业伙伴的赏识，并借此争取自己想要的东西。台湾的科技记者陈良榕告诉我，去年11月，当黄仁勋需要台积电为英伟达提供更多产能时，他飞往台湾，与台积电高管一起吃火锅。他还耐心地为台积电员工在威士忌酒瓶上签名。

Mr. Chen explained why that mattered. Squeezing more chips out of a busy factory took many managers willing to rearrange production and staff willing to work overtime. Mr. Chen, who writes the newsletter Tech Taiwan, suspected they would not have been as eager to do it for other American tech giants because none of them had gone to the great lengths as Mr. Huang in cultivating relationships.
撰写科技电子报《胡说科技》的陈良榕解释了这些举动为什么重要。让已经满负荷运转的工厂生产更多芯片需要许多管理人员愿意重新安排生产计划，也需要员工愿意加班。他认为，如果换成其他美国科技巨头，台积电的员工未必会如此积极地配合，因为没有哪家公司像黄仁勋那样，在培养关系上投入如此多的心力。
台北临江夜市一家香肠摊挂着摊主与黄仁勋的合影。
黄仁勋光顾过的餐馆会像展示好莱坞明星一样挂出他的照片和签名。
台北富霸王餐厅展示着黄仁勋签名的盘子和留言。

A longtime semiconductor analyst, who was not authorized to speak publicly, told me that without Nvidia there would be no A.I. as we see it today. Suppliers have grown accustomed to taking their cues from Mr. Huang, he said, who had a sense of where the technology was headed and was able to persuade the companies to go along with him despite the risks at times. With him gone, the analyst wondered whose judgment they would trust.
一名长期研究半导体行业的分析师告诉我，没有英伟达，就不会有我们今天所看到的人工智能。由于未经授权公开发言，这名分析师要求匿名。他说，供应商们已经习惯了听从黄仁勋的指引。黄仁勋对技术的发展方向有着敏锐的判断，即使有时需要承担风险，也能说服这些公司跟随他的步伐。如今黄仁勋离开了，这名分析师不禁要问，今后他们还会信任谁的判断。
“We hope things won’t change too much because he understands Taiwan better than anyone.” Chin-Tsang Ho, Taiwan’s deputy minister of economic affairs, told me just hours before Mr. Huang stepped down.
“我们希望事情不要发生太大变化，因为没有人比他更了解台湾，”就在黄仁勋辞职前几小时，台湾经济部次长何晋沧告诉我。

Four days before Mr. Huang’s resignation, TSMC was arranging a call with Mr. Huang to discuss plans for the next few years, said Chun-Hsien Yeh, who heads Taiwan’s National Development Council and sits on TSMC’s board. Mr. Yeh told me he expected Mr. Huang’s resignation would have little impact on TSMC, however. Demand for A.I. chips was already exceeding supply, and other customers, including AMD, needed them, too. “If Nvidia takes less,” he said. “others will take more.”
台湾国家发展委员会主委、台积电董事叶俊显说，黄仁勋辞职四天前，台积电还正安排与黄仁勋通话，讨论未来几年的计划。不过，他告诉我，预计黄仁勋的辞职不会对台积电产生太大影响。人工智能芯片的需求已经超过供应，包括AMD在内的其他客户也需要这些芯片。“如果英伟达拿得少了，”他说，“其他公司就会拿得更多。”

Quite a few people I talked to, including semiconductor insiders, said they believed that Mr. Huang didn’t deserve the treatment. “We felt the process didn’t seem quite fair,” Da-Xiang Hu, a tech professional in Taipei, told me. “We felt it all happened too fast.”
我采访的许多人，包括半导体行业内部人士，都认为黄仁勋不应该受到这样的对待。“我们觉得整个过程似乎不太公平，”台北科技业从业者胡大湘（音）告诉我。“我们觉得一切发生得太快了。”

A few even saw his downfall in conspiratorial terms, imagining that other American business and political leaders grew wary of the growing influence of tech executives of Taiwanese and Chinese descent and worked to push Mr. Huang out.
少数人甚至从阴谋论角度看待他的失势，猜测其他美国商界和政界领袖对台湾和华裔科技高管日益增长的影响力感到警惕，因此设法将黄仁勋排挤出局。
台北临江夜市的“阿婆水果”。
台北花娘小馆展示的一块有黄仁勋签名的英伟达显卡。

Other people were annoyed that their Nvidia shares fell. In a place where many people own shares in TSMC, social media quickly filled with joking anxieties about the fate of that company. On Threads, one user posted a photo of TSMC’s chief executive, Che-Chia Wei, captioning it, “Please don’t have an affair. Please. Please.” A commenter responded, “If you do have an affair, please don’t choose a Chinese spy. Please ” Both the post and the comment were liked tens of thousands of times.
另一些人则因英伟达股价下跌而恼火。在台湾，许多人持有台积电股票，社交媒体上很快出现了很多对这家公司的命运带有调侃意味的担忧。在Threads上，一名用户发布了台积电董事长魏哲家的照片，配文写道：“拜托不要有婚外情。拜托，拜托。”一名网友回复：“如果你真的要搞婚外情，拜托千万不要找中国间谍。拜托。”这条帖子和评论都获得了数万次点赞。
Many Taiwanese commentators and social media users are supportive of Mr. Huang. They thanked him for bringing business to the island and for shining a spotlight on its companies.
许多台湾评论人士和社交媒体用户支持黄仁勋。他们感谢他为台湾带来生意，并让台湾公司受到关注。

Emmy Hu, a financial content creator, wrote on Facebook that other tech giants had squeezed Taiwanese suppliers on price. “His generosity toward Taiwan was unusual,” she wrote of Mr. Huang. Yu Ting-hao, a financial commentator, called Mr. Huang “Taiwan’s biggest advocate” on his YouTube program. Kang Wen-teng, who runs a hot pot restaurant in Taichung City, told me he wanted people to remember what Mr. Huang had done for Taiwan. “Thank you, Papa Huang,” he wrote on Threads.
财经内容创作者胡采苹在Facebook上写道，其他科技巨头曾在价格上压榨台湾供应商。“他对台湾的慷慨非同寻常，”她这样评价黄仁勋。财经评论员游庭皓在自己的YouTube节目中称黄仁勋是“台湾的最大代言人”。台中市一家火锅店老板康文腾（音）告诉我，他希望人们记住黄仁勋为台湾所做的一切。“谢谢你，黄爸，”他在Threads上写道。

Still, the accusations that Mr. Huang had an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese intelligence asset troubled even his fans. Da-Xiang Hu, the tech professional in Taipei, told me how moved she was whenever Mr. Huang spoke about Taiwan abroad. After decades of Chinese pressure that has kept Taiwan isolated internationally, hearing him say “Taiwan” mattered to her. At the same time, she said, she feels uneasy about Mr. Huang’s public push to sell advanced chips to China. In a Threads post in which she thanked him, Ms. Hu wondered whether Nvidia’s chips might someday help a Chinese missile strike Taiwan more precisely. “I wish you well,” she wrote, “and I hope Taiwan stays safe.”

不过，即使是黄仁勋的支持者，也对他被指与一名涉嫌为中国情报机构提供情报的女性发生婚外情感到不安。台北科技业从业者胡大湘告诉我，每当黄仁勋在海外谈起台湾时，她都很感动。几十年来，中国的施压使台湾在国际上遭到孤立，因此，听到黄仁勋公开说出“台湾”二字，对她有着特殊的意义。但与此同时，黄仁勋公开推动向中国出售先进芯片也让她感到不安。在Threads上一则感谢黄仁勋的帖子中，胡大湘担心，英伟达的芯片有朝一日是否可能帮助中国的导弹更精确地打击台湾。“祝你一切顺利，”她写道，“也希望台湾平安。”
台北临江夜市冰世界甜品店的店主。
黄仁勋每次到访台湾都会掀起一股狂热，人们将这种现象称为“仁来疯”。
In Taiwan, there is even chatter that maybe Mr. Huang could come back and become the chief executive or a board member of TSMC.
在台湾，甚至有人开始议论，也许黄仁勋可以回来，出任台积电首席执行官或董事会成员。

To Mr. Wang, the hairstylist, Mr. Huang was both a visionary entrepreneur and an old friend. He was planning to write to him. “If he comes back to Taiwan,” he said, “I’m sure he’d come in for a haircut.”
在发型师王永泰看来，黄仁勋既是一位富有远见的企业家，也是一位老朋友。他正打算给黄仁勋写信。“如果他回到台湾，”他说，“我相信他一定还会来找我剪头发。”
摄影：许安荣

items.body:
英伟达据报曾就员工涉向中国大陆走私晶片案向台湾官员求助

美国科技巨企英伟达一名员工被台湾检方指控协助向中国大陆走私人工智能（AI）晶片后，公司向台湾官员寻求协助，再次引发外界质疑英伟达如何看待自身在遏制非法贸易中所扮演的角色。

彭博社星期天（11月15日）引述知情人士透露，英伟达曾为公司一名张姓经理7月被捕向台湾政府官员表达关切。该经理8月被控伪造文书和背信罪。

台湾检方称，张姓经理是一个网络的“核心人物”（core figure），该网络涉嫌将74台装有英伟达晶片的服务器走私至中国大陆，之后再试图转运另外56台服务器，但后者5月被台湾海巡署查获。

知情者称，英伟达的代表告诉台湾官员，公司不认同台湾检方对张姓经理提出的指控，认为他不应受到调查。该经理是此案的九名被告之一。

英伟达在给彭博社的一份声明中说，公司“按照我们的标准做法，对此事进行了彻底调查，没有发现迹象表明我们的员工知道其他公司员工涉嫌转移这些设备的行为”。

上述知情人士透露，台湾政府官员告诉英伟达，他们不参与相关司法程序。该案由台湾基隆地方检察署负责处理。

这是目前已知首宗因涉及晶片转移活动而起诉英伟达员工的案件。随着英伟达应对长期担任首席执行官的黄仁勋上周被免职，这场审讯将受到密切关注。

尽管台湾对英伟达的生存至关重要，公司在这个制造基地却没有政府关系总监，最近才发布这一职位的招聘信息。

知情人士透露，在试图处理这起走私案时，英伟达向其主要生产合作伙伴、台湾科技业关键企业台积电寻求建议。台积电拒绝介入。

对于与台积电及台湾政府官员的接触，英伟达表示，“我们与有关方面进行了沟通，任何公司都会这样做，以提供台湾有关部门要求的信息，并确保我们员工的福祉，希望此事能尽快得到解决。”

台湾经济部没有回应彭博社置评请求，台积电拒予置评。

诈骗集团冒名黄仁勋 称被美国政府陷害急借百万新台币

台湾有民众收到陌生短信，自称是英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋，因遭到美国政府陷害，急需100万新台币，即可揭开阴谋。台湾警方分析是诈骗集团消息，呼吁民众警觉。

据台湾《联合报》报道，假冒信息还承诺将以提供资金者姓名命名显卡，“我承诺回归执行长职位后，会以你的名字设计RTX6090显卡”。民众接获简讯后截图上传网络，引发关注留言，称“诈骗跟得上流行”。

台湾刑事局调查，信息通过苹果手机iMessage发送，目前并无受理诈骗报案纪录。警方分析，诈团利用时事话题，以企业领袖、战地医生等名义，广发简讯吸引民众，一旦收到回讯询问，会将该门号标记为“活跃有效号码”，锁定成行骗目标，后续可能以假投资、假交友或假劝募等手法，诱使交付财物。

台湾警方提醒，诈团或会大量传简讯，民众应留意来源真实性，“跨国企业执行长绝不可能透过私人简讯向民众借贷或募资”，包括“急需资金周转”、“协助渡过难关”、“高额投资回报”、“赠送未上市限量商品”、“专属命名权”，都是话术。

items.body:
中国10月新房价格同比降幅为11个月最小

中国国家统计局星期一（11月16日）发布70个大中城市商品住宅销售价格变动情况的最新数据显示，中国10月一线城市新房价格同比下降0.1%，降幅比上月收窄0.4个百分点。其中北京跌幅最大为2.6%，比上月收窄0.1个百分点。广州和深圳分别下降0.4%和0.2%，上海上涨2.7%。

官方数据显示，二、三线城市新房售价同比分别下降2.0%和3.6%，降幅分别收窄0.4个和0.3个百分点。

路透社根据统计局数据计算得出，中国10月新房价格同比下滑2.4%，较9月同比下降2.8%收窄0.4个百分点，为2025年11月以来的最小降幅。

此外，官方数据也显示，中国10月一线城市新房环比价格总体上涨，二三线城市环比下降。

数据指出，中国10月一线城市新房价格环比由上月上涨0.1%转为持平。其中上海和深圳分别上涨0.2%和0.1%，广州持平，北京下降0.1%。二线城市新房价格环比由上月持平转为下降0.1%。三线城市新房价格环比下降0.2%，降幅与上月相同。70个大中城市中，新房价格环比上涨城市有14个，比上月减少三个。

items.body:
ALI WATKINS2026年11月16日

Megaspeed位于新加坡的办公室。该公司表示，前高管黄乐目前在公司没有担任任何职务。美国官员指控她为中国从事间谍活动。 Taryn Ng/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images

Megaspeed, the Singaporean data center company, said in a statement on Sunday that Alice Huang, a former executive at the center of what U.S. officials call a Chinese spy plot targeting the Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang, had left the company in August 2025.

新加坡数据中心公司Megaspeed周日发表声明称，前高管黄乐已于2025年8月离职。黄乐是美国官员所称的一起针对英伟达联合创始人黄仁勋的中国间谍阴谋的核心人物。

The statement, which was reported by The Associated Press, was Megaspeed’s first to directly address the status of Ms. Huang since she became the focus of international scrutiny over her ties to Mr. Huang, who resigned from Nvidia on Thursday.

据美联社报道，这是自黄乐因与黄仁勋的关系受到国际社会密切关注以来，Megaspeed首次直接回应她在公司的任职情况。黄仁勋已于周四从英伟达辞职。

News of their relationship rocked Nvidia, the dominant maker of artificial intelligence chips, as well as the global technology sector and the U.S. government.

两人关系的曝光震动了英伟达这家人工智能芯片领域的主导企业，也波及全球科技行业和美国政府。

Last month, The New York Times reported that American officials had concluded Ms. Huang was a Chinese intelligence asset and had a close relationship with Mr. Huang, one of the most powerful figures in the A.I. boom and an adviser to President Trump.

上个月，《纽约时报》报道称，美国官员已认定黄乐是中国情报机构的一名情报人员，并与黄仁勋关系密切。黄仁勋是人工智能热潮中最有影响力的人物之一，也是特朗普总统的顾问。

Mr. Huang acknowledged last Sunday that he’d had an affair with Ms. Huang, and Nvidia’s board of directors said they had begun an investigation into his conduct. On Wednesday, The New York Times reported that he also had an extramarital relationship with an executive at Nvidia who reported to him. He abruptly stepped down as chief executive the next day from the company he had led for more than 30 years.

The scandal has trained attention on Megaspeed, a small company that purchased billions of dollars of Nvidia’s coveted chips from 2024 to 2026.

“Megaspeed不对黄女士的个人及私事发表评论，”该公司在发给美联社的电子邮件声明中表示。

Megaspeed提供的有关黄乐任职时间的信息尚无法得到独立核实。周日发表这份声明之前，美国和新加坡当局已对该公司进行了长达一年多的审查。

“公司已聘请外部法律顾问进行彻底的内部调查，”Megaspeed还表示。

Ms. Huang has not responded to requests for comment. China has denied the espionage claims.

黄乐尚未回应置评请求。中国否认了有关间谍活动的指控。

The Times reported in October 2025 that Ms. Huang had stepped down from the company months earlier, citing a human resources manager, though it was unclear where she went.

Last week, the government of Singapore said it had confiscated Ms. Huang’s passport from June 2025 to February 2026 over “potential false declarations” about Megaspeed. She was ultimately released and barred from re-entering Singapore.

上周，新加坡政府表示，由于黄乐在Megaspeed的相关事务中“可能作出虚假申报”，当局曾于2025年6月至2026年2月期间扣押她的护照。她最终获释，但被禁止再次入境新加坡。

U.S. officials, including Secretary of State Marco Rubio, had informed Mr. Trump of concerns about Ms. Huang and her relationship with Mr. Huang as early as October 2025.

包括国务卿马可·鲁比奥在内的美国官员，早在2025年10月就已向特朗普通报了对黄乐及其与黄仁勋关系的担忧。

Mr. Trump declined to take action. This May, Mr. Trump brought Mr. Huang with him on a trip to China, another sign of Mr. Huang’s importance to the A.I. data center boom that is a key driver of the American economy.

特朗普没有采取行动。今年5月，特朗普还带着黄仁勋一同访问中国。这再次表明，黄仁勋对于人工智能数据中心建设热潮的重要性，而这股热潮正是美国经济增长的关键驱动力之一。

The scandal has touched off a new round infighting in the Trump administration over its approach to A.I. and China.

这场丑闻引发了特朗普政府内部围绕人工智能及对华政策的新一轮内斗。

Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, a prominent voice in favor of allowing U.S. companies like Nvidia to sell products in Asia, has faced accusations from others in the administration and in Congress that his department has been too cozy with Nvidia and Mr. Huang.

财长斯科特·贝森特周五表示，财政部和其他部门支持将Megaspeed列入贸易黑名单，但只有商务部才有权采取这一步骤。商务部表示，此类决定需要整个政府共同作出。

Mr. Bessent said on Sunday that Nvidia should look externally for a new chief executive. On “Sunday Morning Futures” on Fox News, he said that the company needs “a dramatic shake-up.”

贝森特周日表示，英伟达应该从公司外部寻找新任首席执行官。他在福克斯新闻的《周日早间期货》节目中说，该公司需要“一场大刀阔斧的变革”。

He added that the company’s board and outside counsel within the next 10 days needed to answer questions ​about the company’s culture of compliance with export ⁠restrictions.

他还表示，英伟达董事会及外部法律顾问必须在未来10天内，就公司遵守出口管制规定的合规文化回应外界的质疑。

items.body:
储百亮2026年11月16日

中央军委副主席张升民周四在北京出席会议。他最近被提拔进入中国共产党最高领导机构中共中央政治局。 Maxim Shemetov/Reuters

When China’s leader, Xi Jinping, endorsed the expulsion of dozens of disgraced officials at a recent Communist Party meeting in Beijing, one man stood out as a clear winner.

当中国领导人习近平在最近于北京举行的共产党会议上批准开除数十名失势官员时，有一人显然成为最大赢家。

Taking his new place at the front of the meeting was Gen. Zhang Shengmin, the somber-faced enforcer of Mr. Xi’s purges inside the military. He had been promoted to the Politburo, the party’s top leadership council, the latest step in his improbable rise from low-profile inspector to a position second only to Mr. Xi in China’s military hierarchy.

坐在会议前排新位置上的是张升民将军，这位面色凝重的人物是习近平军内整风行动的执行者。他已被提拔进入中共最高领导机构中央政治局。这是他令人难以置信的晋升之路上的最新一步，他从一名行事低调的纪检干部一路升至在中国军队高层中地位仅次于习近平的位置。

General Zhang has been the principal overseer of Mr. Xi’s campaign to purify the People’s Liberation Army. His latest elevation signaled that the investigations, indoctrination drives and loyalty tests could continue for years, as Mr. Xi searches for officers he believes are irreproachably loyal, experts and officials said.

张升民一直是习近平净化人民解放军运动的主要监督者；专家和官员表示，他的最新晋升表明，随着习近平继续物色他认为忠诚度无可挑剔的军官，这些调查、政治思想教育运动和忠诚度测试可能会持续数年。

“Twist the blade inward, with strict measures to cure disorder,” China’s main military newspaper said after the party meeting that was held late last month, referring to the continued discipline campaign.

“刀刃向内，重典治乱，”中国主要的军事报纸在上个月底举行的党内会议结束后表示，这是指持续进行的纪律整顿运动。

Three officials in Taiwan said they believed Mr. Xi’s loyalty campaign would keep the Chinese military focused on its own problems. That could hinder preparations for possible war over Taiwan, the self-governed island democracy that Beijing claims. The officials spoke on condition of anonymity to discuss internal assessments.

台湾的三位官员表示，他们认为，习近平的忠诚运动将使中国军队继续专注于自身的问题。这可能会阻碍针对台湾可能爆发的战争的准备工作。台湾是一个民主自治岛屿，北京声称对其拥有主权。这些官员在讨论内部评估时要求匿名。

The leadership uncertainty comes as China’s military has continued to pressure Taiwan. Dozens of P.L.A. ships held unannounced drills in seas off the Chinese coast in recent weeks, with some, including a carrier strike group, still remaining, Joseph Wu, the secretary-general of Taiwan’s National Security Council, posted on X on Thursday.

就在这种领导层的不确定性出现之际，中国军队还在继续对台湾施加压力。台湾国家安全会议秘书长吴钊燮周四在X平台上发文称，最近几周，数十艘解放军舰艇在中国沿海海域举行了未经宣布的演习，其中一些舰艇（包括一个航母打击群）仍然留在该海域。

But the exercises appeared less sophisticated than earlier ones — potentially reflecting disruptions to the P.L.A. command, another Taiwanese official said. He spoke on the condition of anonymity, citing rules about sharing military intelligence with reporters.

但另一位台湾官员表示，此次演习的复杂程度似乎低于此前几次，这可能反映了解放军指挥系统出现了紊乱。由于涉及与记者分享军事情报的规定，他要求匿名。

John Culver, a former Central Intelligence Agency analyst who studied the Chinese military, said that “Xi’s animating motivation isn’t war or preserving his own power as goals in and of themselves.”

曾研究过中国军队的前中央情报局分析师约翰·卡尔弗表示，“习近平的核心动机并不是把发动战争或维护自身权力作为本身的目标。”

“It’s saving the party, and ensuring that the P.L.A. will fulfill its role as the armed wing of the Chinese Communist Party,” said Mr. Culver, a nonresident senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, referring to the People’s Liberation Army.

“他的目的是拯救党，并确保解放军能够履行其作为中国共产党武装力量的角色，”布鲁金斯学会非常驻高级研究员卡尔弗说。

A Military Leader With a Political Background

有政治背景的军事领导人

General Zhang’s promotion was unusual. He was the first official in 32 years to join the Politburo outside its regular five-year leadership cycle.

张升民的晋升非同寻常。他是32年来首位在常规五年领导任期周期之外进入政治局的高官。

He has scant experience in leading military operations. He was for many years a political officer, enforcing party rule over the military, and then an investigator hunting for corruption and misbehavior. Outside the military, he became best known for his Chinese brushstroke calligraphy.

他在领导军事行动方面缺乏经验。多年来，他一直是一名政治军官，负责执行党对军队的领导，后来又成为负责追查腐败和违纪行为的调查员。在军队之外，他最广为人知的是他的中国毛笔书法。

His rise is the story of Mr. Xi’s declining faith in many of his handpicked generals. Dozens have been removed, often accused of corruption and betraying Mr. Xi’s orders.

这种情况在2023年开始发生改变，当时他领导的调查人员将目标对准了中国火箭军，并罢免了被控腐败的指挥官。调查范围随后蔓延到了其他军种以及军队更高层级。

As the scandals spread, General Zhang became increasingly important to Mr. Xi’s renewed drive to clean out generals accused of defying him and taking bribes.
随着丑闻蔓延，在习近平重新发起的清除那些被指控违抗命令及收受贿赂的将领的行动中，张升民变得越来越重要。

That campaign reached a peak early this year, when Gen. Zhang Youxia, China’s most senior uniformed officer, was placed under investigation, along with Gen. Liu Zhenli, the chief of the Joint Staff Department. He gained that position in October.

张升民最近晋升入政治局，增加了他在明年年底共产党代表大会之后继续担任中国最高将领的可能性，届时习近平几乎肯定会赢得第四个任期。现年68岁的张升民若留任，年龄将超过常规限制，但习近平已经为某些官员打破了退休规范。尽管如此，这些清洗行动还是发出了一个警告：即便是习近平身边的亲信，其地位也并非稳如磐石。
General Zhang “could be discarded at any point,” said Mr. Culver, of the Brookings Institution. “If there’s one lesson we should have drawn, it is that there are no essential Xi allies.”
布鲁金斯学会的卡尔弗表示，张升民“随时可能被抛弃”。“如果说我们应该吸取一个教训的话，那就是，没有谁是习近平不可或缺的盟友。”

items.body:
JULIAN E. BARNES, MAGGIE HABERMAN, JONATHAN SWAN2026年11月16日

情报机构仍有许多关于黄乐的疑点需要厘清，而她与黄仁勋的关系正受到密切审视。 CTI, via Reuters

Alice Huang, the Chinese executive at the center of the Nvidia spying scandal, was believed to be using her affair with Nvidia’s founder to help China get around U.S. efforts to restrict access to advanced A.I. chips, people who have read U.S. intelligence reporting said.

据看过美国情报报告的人士透露，处于英伟达间谍丑闻中心的中国高管黄乐(Alice Huang)据信利用她与英伟达创始人的婚外情，帮助中国规避美国为限制先进人工智能芯片获取渠道而采取的措施。

But there remains much that intelligence agencies are still assessing about Ms. Huang including when she began working with China’s top spy agency, whether her cooperation was willing or coerced, how much direction Beijing gave her, and how much she relayed to officials there, the people said.

但这些人士表示，情报机构仍在评估关于黄乐的许多问题，包括她何时开始与中国最高情报机构合作、这种合作是出于自愿还是受到胁迫、北京给了她多少指示，以及她向中国官员传递了多少信息。

Her relationship with Jensen Huang, who stepped down as Nvidia’s chief executive on Thursday, gave her potential access to crucial information about the company’s technology, Mr. Huang’s strategic thinking and his knowledge of Washington’s debates about A.I. policy.

她与黄仁勋的关系使她有机会接触到关键信息，比如英伟达的技术、黄仁勋的战略思维，以及他对华盛顿人工智能政策辩论的了解。黄仁勋于周四辞去英伟达首席执行官职务。

She also had a business interest in ensuring a flow of chips to her own company, one of a number in Southeast Asia that provided Chinese tech firms with the computing power needed to train advanced artificial intelligence models.

她本人也有商业利益上的动机，希望确保芯片能够持续流入自己的公司。这家公司是东南亚多家为中国科技企业提供算力的公司之一，这些算力被用于训练先进的人工智能模型。

The aftershocks of the scandal continue to play out as President Trump prepares for a trip next week to Asia, where he is scheduled to meet with President Xi Jinping of China, who has made a top priority of catching the United States in the race for A.I. dominance.

丑闻的余波仍在持续发酵，而特朗普总统正准备访问亚洲，期间将与中国国家主席习近平会面，后者已将中国在人工智能主导权争夺战中赶上美国列为首要任务之一。

The unknowns surrounding Ms. Huang have generated intense scrutiny of how Chinese intelligence operates, prompted questions of what it means to be a spy and given backers of Mr. Huang an opening to raise questions about the extent and nature of her role.

围绕黄乐的种种疑点使中国情报机构的运作方式受到高度关注，也引发了关于究竟怎样才算间谍的讨论，同时让黄仁勋的支持者有机会质疑黄乐所扮演角色的性质及其参与程度。

Mr. Trump, who has viewed Mr. Huang as an important ally in his push to maintain American superiority in A.I. as well as a key driver of the U.S. economy, has defended the former Nvidia leader. On Thursday he seemed to suggest that he was less sure than are U.S. intelligence agencies that Mr. Huang had been the target of a Chinese intelligence operation.

但特朗普视黄仁勋为维持美国在人工智能领域优势的重要盟友，也是美国经济的关键推动者，他一直为这位英伟达前领导人辩护。周四，他似乎暗示，自己不像美国情报机构那样确信黄仁勋是中国情报行动的目标。

黄仁勋于周四辞去英伟达首席执行官职务，他可能让黄乐得以接触有关英伟达技术的关键信息。

“The big thing is, was the woman a spy, and I don’t know if that’s been determined yet,” Mr. Trump said in an interview with Stephen A. Smith, the podcaster and sports commentator, when asked if Mr. Huang should have resigned. “But if the woman was a spy, yes. If the woman was not a spy perhaps it would be different.”

“最关键的是，那个女人是不是间谍，我不知是否已有定论，”特朗普在接受播客兼体育评论员斯蒂芬·史密斯采访时被问及黄仁勋是否应该辞职，他如此说道。“但如果那个女人是间谍，那是的。如果她不是间谍，情况或许就不一样了。”

Still, the concerns in the U.S. intelligence community that Ms. Huang was spying on behalf of Beijing were taken so seriously that Mr. Trump was twice briefed on it, late last year and again this spring.

尽管如此，美国情报界对黄乐涉嫌为北京从事间谍活动的担忧极为严重，以至于特朗普曾两次就此听取情报简报，分别是在去年年底和今年春天。

One of those briefings was by Marco Rubio, the secretary of state and national security adviser. Mr. Rubio had overseen the drafting of a memo, dated March 30, sent to a handful of Cabinet secretaries, that detailed Ms. Huang’s close relationship with the Nvidia founder and her contacts with China’s main civilian intelligence service, the Ministry of State Security.

其中一次简报由国务卿兼国家安全顾问马可·鲁比奥所做。鲁比奥曾主持起草了一份日期为3月30日的备忘录，发送给少数几位内阁部长，其中详细说明了黄乐与英伟达创始人的密切关系，以及她与中国主要的非军事情报机构——国家安全部之间的联系。

Mr. Trump said this week that Mr. Huang had told him he did not know Ms. Huang was tied to Chinese intelligence. Ms. Huang has not responded to outreach from The New York Times.

特朗普本周表示，黄仁勋曾告诉他，自己并不知道黄乐与中国情报机构有关联。黄乐未回应《纽约时报》的置评请求。

Ms. Huang was a top executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that purchased Nvidia chips and built data centers in Southeast Asia whose customers included Alibaba, the Chinese commerce giant.

黄乐曾是总部位于新加坡的Megaspeed公司的一名高管。该公司购买英伟达芯片，并在东南亚建设数据中心，客户包括中国电商巨头阿里巴巴。

The Commerce Department launched an investigation into whether Megaspeed was helping illegally divert Nvidia chips to China, an inquiry launched well before the current scandal emerged and subsequently taken over last year by the Justice Department. Authorities in Singapore also questioned Ms. Huang last year. Her current whereabouts is unknown.

美国商务部此前已对Megaspeed展开调查，以确定该公司是否协助将英伟达芯片非法转运至中国。这项调查早在当前丑闻曝光之前就已启动，并于去年移交司法部。新加坡当局去年也曾对黄乐进行问询。目前尚不清楚她身在何处。

Attorney General Todd Blanche said at a news conference on Thursday that the Justice Department has a role in investigating whether advanced chips had been sold to China in violation of U.S. export controls.

美国司法部长托德·布兰奇周四在新闻发布会上表示，司法部有责任调查是否存在违反美国出口管制规定、向中国出售先进芯片的行为。

“If there are chips that shouldn’t be sold it could potentially be a violation of our export laws,” Mr. Blanche said. “That could be civil, regulatory, it could also be criminal, depending on the case. And that investigation is ongoing.”

“如果某些芯片本不应该出售，那么这可能违反我们的出口法律，”布兰奇说。“这可能涉及民事、监管层面，根据具体情况也可能涉及刑事。相关调查正在进行中。”

Mr. Blanche sidestepped a question about whether the Justice Department has made an assessment about the nature of Ms. Huang’s role.

当被问及司法部是否已经对黄乐所扮演角色的性质作出评估时，布兰奇回避了这个问题。

Multiple people who have reviewed the underlying U.S. intelligence said that it showed that Ms. Huang was working with the Chinese intelligence agency.

多名审阅过相关美国情报原始材料的人士表示，这些情报显示，黄乐一直在与中国情报机构合作。

People briefed on the intelligence say it appears that she was not a trained intelligence officer but rather an “asset,” someone providing information secretly to the Ministry of State Security.

听取过情报简报的人士说，黄乐似乎并非受过专业训练的情报官员，而是一名“情报线人”，即秘密向中国国家安全部提供信息的人。

Chinese espionage is complicated. There are a range of ways that Chinese business executives can conduct espionage for the Beijing government, from simply reporting what they know to taking active direction.

中国的间谍活动十分复杂。中国企业高管为政府从事间谍活动的方式多种多样，从单纯报告自己掌握的信息，到按照情报机构的具体指示采取行动，都有可能。

U.S. intelligence agencies have confidence in their information about her interactions with Chinese intelligence services, despite all that they do not know about Ms. Huang.

尽管美国情报机构对黄乐仍有诸多不了解之处，但对有关她与中国情报部门接触情报一事仍然有信心。

Current and former officials said that Chinese business executives often believe that they cannot advance their careers without being aligned with the state. Approached by the Chinese government to collect information or prod an American company for access to high-end chips, many Chinese executives might feel they have no choice but to comply.

现任和前任官员表示，中国商界高管往往认为，如果不与国家保持一致，就无法推进自己的事业。当中国政府找上门来，要求收集信息或设法让美国公司开放高端芯片渠道时，许多中国高管可能会觉得自己别无选择，只能配合。

The U.S. intelligence community has been gathering surveillance on Ms. Huang for well over a year. She was already in a close relationship with Mr. Huang when the surveillance began, people familiar with the situation said.

美国情报界对黄乐的监控已持续一年多。知情人士表示，监控开始时，她已经与黄仁勋建立了亲密关系。

Determining when Ms. Huang started providing information to the Ministry of State Security is important as American intelligence tries to better understand what details she might have gathered during her affair with Mr. Huang.

美国情报机构正试图进一步查明黄乐在与黄仁勋保持婚外情关系期间可能获取了哪些信息。为此，确定她究竟从何时开始向中国国家安全部提供情报就显得尤为重要。

Mr. Huang stepped down from Nvidia after admitting to an affair and after the company’s board began investigating his relationship with Ms. Huang. The board pushed for Mr. Huang’s resignation not just because of the spying allegations. On Wednesday, The New York Times reported Mr. Huang had conducted another affair with an executive who reported directly to him.

黄仁勋在承认婚外情、公司董事会开始调查他与黄乐的关系后辞去了英伟达的职务。董事会推动黄仁勋辞职，并不只是因为间谍指控。周三，《纽约时报》报道称，黄仁勋还曾与一名直接向他汇报工作的公司高管发生婚外情。

Julian E. Barnes为《纽约时报》报道美国情报机构和国际安全事务。他撰写安全相关议题已有20余年。

Maggie Haberman是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。

Jonathan Swan是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。

“如果某些芯片本不应该出售，那么这可能违反我们的出口法律，”布兰奇说。“这可能涉及民事、监管层面，根据具体情况也可能涉及刑事。相关调查正在进行中。”
Mr. Blanche sidestepped a question about whether the Justice Department has made an assessment about the nature of Ms. Huang’s role.
当被问及司法部是否已经对黄乐所扮演角色的性质作出评估时，布兰奇回避了这个问题。
Multiple people who have reviewed the underlying U.S. intelligence said that it showed that Ms. Huang was working with the Chinese intelligence agency.
多名审阅过相关美国情报原始材料的人士表示，这些情报显示，黄乐一直在与中国情报机构合作。
People briefed on the intelligence say it appears that she was not a trained intelligence officer but rather an “asset,” someone providing information secretly to the Ministry of State Security.
听取过情报简报的人士说，黄乐似乎并非受过专业训练的情报官员，而是一名“情报线人”，即秘密向中国国家安全部提供信息的人。

Chinese espionage is complicated. There are a range of ways that Chinese business executives can conduct espionage for the Beijing government, from simply reporting what they know to taking active direction.
中国的间谍活动十分复杂。中国企业高管为政府从事间谍活动的方式多种多样，从单纯报告自己掌握的信息，到按照情报机构的具体指示采取行动，都有可能。

尽管美国情报机构对黄乐仍有诸多不了解之处，但对有关她与中国情报部门接触情报一事仍然有信心。

Current and former officials said that Chinese business executives often believe that they cannot advance their careers without being aligned with the state. Approached by the Chinese government to collect information or prod an American company for access to high-end chips, many Chinese executives might feel they have no choice but to comply.
现任和前任官员表示，中国商界高管往往认为，如果不与国家保持一致，就无法推进自己的事业。当中国政府找上门来，要求收集信息或设法让美国公司开放高端芯片渠道时，许多中国高管可能会觉得自己别无选择，只能配合。

The U.S. intelligence community has been gathering surveillance on Ms. Huang for well over a year. She was already in a close relationship with Mr. Huang when the surveillance began, people familiar with the situation said.
美国情报界对黄乐的监控已持续一年多。知情人士表示，监控开始时，她已经与黄仁勋建立了亲密关系。

Determining when Ms. Huang started providing information to the Ministry of State Security is important as American intelligence tries to better understand what details she might have gathered during her affair with Mr. Huang.
美国情报机构正试图进一步查明黄乐在与黄仁勋保持婚外情关系期间可能获取了哪些信息。为此，确定她究竟从何时开始向中国国家安全部提供情报就显得尤为重要。

Mr. Huang stepped down from Nvidia after admitting to an affair and after the company’s board began investigating his relationship with Ms. Huang. The board pushed for Mr. Huang’s resignation not just because of the spying allegations. On Wednesday, The New York Times reported Mr. Huang had conducted another affair with an executive who reported directly to him.
黄仁勋在承认婚外情、公司董事会开始调查他与黄乐的关系后辞去了英伟达的职务。董事会推动黄仁勋辞职，并不只是因为间谍指控。周三，《纽约时报》报道称，黄仁勋还曾与一名直接向他汇报工作的公司高管发生婚外情。
Julian E. Barnes为《纽约时报》报道美国情报机构和国际安全事务。他撰写安全相关议题已有20余年。

KATIE ROGERS2026年11月16日

At major moments in President Trump’s second term, he has looked up during an economic speech or diplomatic dinner and asked a version of the same question: “Where’s Jensen?”

在特朗普总统第二任期的几个重要时刻，他曾在发表经济演讲或出席外交晚宴时抬起头，问出一个大致相同的问题：“詹森在哪儿？”

Jensen Huang has usually been out there, somewhere in the room.

黄仁勋通常就在现场，在场内的某个地方。

Mr. Huang, who was until Thursday the leather-jacketed chief executive of Nvidia, one of the world’s largest companies, had impressed the president with his success, his money and his argument that keeping China dependent on American-made semiconductor chips and technology could help maintain U.S. dominance over Beijing.

直到周四前，黄仁勋还是全球最大企业之一英伟达的那个身穿皮夹克的首席执行官。他凭借自身的成功、财富，以及这样一种论点给总统留下了深刻印象：让中国保持对美国制造的半导体芯片和技术的依赖，有助于维持美国对北京的压制优势。

Mr. Trump made sure to have the technology executive with him during pivotal U.S.-China meetings this year. The president invited him to come to China in May when he went to meet with Xi Jinping, China’s leader, stopping in Alaska, where Mr. Huang joined him on Air Force One at the last minute. And Mr. Huang was at the head table with the president when Mr. Trump hosted a state dinner for Mr. Xi at the White House in September.

今年在美中两国举行关键会晤期间，特朗普都特意让这位科技高管随行。5月前往中国会见中国领导人习近平时，总统邀请他同行，并在经停阿拉斯加期间，让黄仁勋在最后一刻登上了“空军一号”。9月特朗普在白宫为习近平举行国宴时，黄仁勋也与总统同坐主桌。

But when Mr. Trump travels to China for another meeting with Mr. Xi at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation in Shenzhen this week, Mr. Huang, the man who has been influential in shaping the president’s views about technological competition with China, is not expected to be at his side.

但当特朗普本周前往中国、在深圳亚太经合组织会议上与习近平再次会晤时，这位影响了总统对华科技竞争看法的人物预计将不会出现在他身旁。

Last week, Mr. Huang stepped down from his role at Nvidia after revelations that he had engaged in affairs, including one with Alice Huang, a woman who U.S. intelligence officials believe is an asset of Beijing.

上周，在被曝出有多段婚外情后，黄仁勋辞去了在英伟达的职务，其中包括与黄乐(Alice Huang)的一段关系——美国情报官员认为该女子是北京的情报线人。

Mr. Huang’s sudden fall and the U.S. finding that he was targeted by Chinese intelligence do not appear to have altered Mr. Trump’s estimation of the former Nvidia leader — or his approach to dealing with his Chinese counterpart in this week’s meeting. (Beijing has called the U.S. intelligence conclusions “smears and slanders.”)

黄仁勋的突然下台，以及美国关于他成为中国情报部门目标的调查结论，似乎并未改变特朗普对这位前英伟达领导人的评价——也未改变他在本周会晤中与中方领导人打交道的方式。（北京方面称美方情报结论是“污蔑抹黑”。）

So far, the president has not pressed Mr. Xi about his country’s espionage efforts or stepped in to resolve a raging debate within his administration about tightening export controls of A.I. technology and certain chips to China. Howard Lutnick, the commerce secretary, who has argued for less strict limits on chip exports to Asia, is expected to travel with him. In Shenzhen, Mr. Trump will participate in a meeting with Mr. Xi and, later, with Mr. Xi and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia, in the first such gathering of the three leaders.

迄今为止，总统尚未就中国的情报活动向习近平施压，也未介入平息政府内部关于收紧对华人工智能技术和特定芯片出口管制的激烈争论。一直主张放宽对亚洲芯片出口限制的商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克预计将随行。在深圳，特朗普将先与习近平举行会晤，随后还将与习近平及俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京共同会晤，这将是三位领导人的首次此类会晤。

“Well, the big thing is, was the woman a spy?” Mr. Trump said in an interview with the podcaster and sports commentator Stephen A. Smith on Thursday, when asked if he thought Mr. Huang should have resigned. “And I don’t know if that’s been determined yet, but if the woman was a spy, yes. If the woman was not a spy, perhaps it would be different. But I can tell you this: Somehow, he’ll end up in his feet. I mean, I know him. I know him pretty well. I always thought of him as a fine man.”

“嗯，关键问题是，那个女人是不是间谍？”特朗普周四在接受播客主持人、体育评论员斯蒂芬·A·史密斯采访时，被问及是否认为黄仁勋应该辞职时这样说道。“我还不知道这件事是否已有定论，但如果那个女人是间谍，那他确实应该辞职。如果那个女人不是间谍，情况也许会有所不同。但我可以告诉你：无论如何，他最终都会重新站稳脚跟的。我是说，我了解他。我相当了解他。我一直觉得他是个好人。”

Mr. Trump said last week that he did not plan to bring up the Nvidia matter with Mr. Xi but suggested that the Chinese leader could bring it up with him.

特朗普上周表示，他不打算向习近平提及英伟达一事，但表示这位中国领导人可能会向他提起此事。

The president also said that he did not recall being briefed that Mr. Huang was in a close relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese executive believed by the United States to be a Chinese intelligence asset.

总统还表示，他不记得曾听取过有关黄仁勋与黄乐关系密切的简报——后者是一名中国高管，被美方认为是中国情报线人。

黄仁勋与特朗普于2025年在白宫的合影。特朗普在周四谈到黄仁勋时说：“我一直觉得他是个好人。” Pete Marovich for The New York Times

But Secretary of State Marco Rubio told Mr. Trump aboard Air Force One in May en route to China about the sensitive intelligence showing that Nvidia’s chief executive was in a relationship with the woman and that she was believed to be a Chinese spy, The New York Times reported last week. It was at least the second time the president was briefed on the intelligence, The Times reported.

但据《纽约时报》上周报道，国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥5月在飞往中国的“空军一号”上就曾向特朗普通报过这份敏感情报，该情报显示，英伟达首席执行官与这位被认为是中国间谍的女子为情人关系。《纽约时报》报道称，这至少是总统第二次听取有关该情报的简报。

Mr. Trump has continued to defend Mr. Huang, calling him an “honorable man” and questioning reports that he was briefed on the government’s intelligence findings.

特朗普继续为黄仁勋辩护，称他是一个“正派的人”，并质疑有关自己曾听取政府情报调查结果简报的报道。

“I’d have to check,” he told reporters last week in response to a question about when he first learned of the matter. “I’d certainly check with the intelligence people. They could have been mentioned. Certainly, it didn’t make much of an impact on me.”

“我得核实一下，”他上周在回答有关何时首次得知此事的提问时对记者说。“我肯定会向情报人员核实。相关情况可能被提起过。但显然，这事没给我留下什么深刻印象。”

The president’s blasé response to espionage allegations that have upended one of the world’s largest companies belies the economic and political storm caused by the revelations of Mr. Huang’s behavior. It also raises questions about how Mr. Trump would conduct himself during his meeting with Mr. Xi, an authoritarian leader whose friendship and admiration the president has courted.

面对已使全球最大企业之一陷入动荡的间谍指控，总统漫不经心的回应与黄仁勋行为曝光所引发的经济与政治风暴形成了鲜明对比。这也让人质疑，特朗普在与习近平会晤时将如何表现——总统一直极力争取这位威权领导人的友谊与赞赏。

“Trump has stood by Huang personally, and my read is that he sees espionage as something major powers just do to each other,” Craig Singleton, a China expert at the Foundation for Defense of Democracies, a nonpartisan think tank, said during a briefing last week. “He wants a very successful meeting and to show that he can manage the relationship with Xi Jinping.”

“特朗普在个人层面上一直支持黄仁勋，我的解读是，他认为间谍活动不过是大国之间彼此都会做的事情，”无党派智库捍卫民主基金会的中国问题专家克雷格·辛格尔顿上周在一场简报会上表示。“他希望这次会晤非常成功，并展示自己能够把握好与习近平的关系。”

Indeed, Mr. Trump has said that espionage is the price of dealing with a powerful adversary. “You know what they say? That China spies on us. I say you’re right, and we spy on them, too,” he said in September.

事实上，特朗普曾表示，间谍活动是与强大对手打交道的代价。“你知道他们怎么说吗？他们说中国对我们搞间谍活动。我说你们说得对，但我们也对他们搞间谍活动，”他在9月说道。

White House officials said Friday that the Nvidia matter was a national security issue, and they did not expect the president to discuss it with Mr. Xi during their encounter.

白宫官员周五表示，英伟达一事属于国家安全问题，他们预计总统不会在会面期间与习近平讨论此事。

In his two previous meetings this year with the Chinese leader, Mr. Trump showed little interest in extracting concessions from China.

在今年此前与中国领导人的两次会晤中，特朗普几乎没有表现出争取中国让步的兴趣。

Mr. Trump struck a conciliatory tone with Mr. Xi during his visit to Beijing in May, emphasizing their personal relationship. And when Mr. Xi visited Washington in the fall, weeks after Mr. Trump decried what he claimed was meddling by Beijing in the 2020 election, the president leaned into the pageantry of the occasion. The state visit produced little in terms of policy announcements on matters of tension between the two countries — on A.I., trade or the war in Iran.

5月访问北京期间，特朗普对习近平采取了和解语调，强调两人的私人关系。秋季习近平访问华盛顿时——就在几周前特朗普还曾谴责他所称的北京对2020年大选的干预——总统却全心投入到盛大的礼宾仪式中。这次国事访问在两国存在分歧的议题上——包括人工智能、贸易或伊朗战争——几乎没有产生任何政策声明。

But as Mr. Trump prepares to head to China again, Mr. Singleton noted that “the politics back in Washington are moving in a very different direction.”

但就在特朗普准备再次前往中国之际，辛格尔顿指出，“华盛顿的政治风向正在朝截然不同的方向发展。”

The Trump administration is now facing questions and criticism over whether officials had properly policed the sale of chips to China. On Friday, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent publicly blamed the Commerce Department for failing to curb the sale of advanced Nvidia technology to the Singaporean firm Megaspeed, which employed Ms. Huang and built data centers that provide computing power to Chinese companies.

特朗普政府目前正因官员们是否妥善监管对华芯片销售而面临质疑和批评。周五，财政部长斯科特·贝森特公开指责商务部未能遏制向新加坡公司Megaspeed出售先进英伟达技术的行为——该公司曾雇用黄乐，并建设了向中国企业提供算力的数据中心。

“You will have to ask them about their internal processes,” he said of the Commerce Department, adding that his own agency had supported a stricter approach. “Treasury and my deputy has been pushing for this for months at the deputies level.”

“你们得去问问他们的内部流程，”他在谈及商务部时说，并补充称他所在的部门一直支持采取更严格的做法。“数月来，财政部和我的副手一直在副部级层面上推动此事。”

Mr. Bessent has led the administration’s efforts to extend a trade truce with Beijing that expires in January. Despite continuing negotiations and the pause of a tit-for-tat trade war, administration officials remain frustrated with China’s restrictions on exports of crucial rare-earth metals and rare-earth magnets. Mr. Trump is expected to bring up that issue with Mr. Xi in Shenzhen.

贝森特一直主导着政府与北京延长贸易休战期的努力，该休战期将于1月到期。尽管谈判仍在继续，且针锋相对的贸易战暂时休止，但政府官员仍对中国的关键稀土金属及磁体出口限制感到不满。预计特朗普将在深圳与习近平会晤时提及这一问题。

While administration officials say the president will focus his meetings on rare-earth exports, nuclear proliferation and the war with Iran, Republicans and Democrats in Washington are demanding answers on Nvidia from Mr. Huang and Mr. Lutnick, who both have been asked to testify before the Senate Banking Committee in December.

尽管政府官员表示总统将在会晤中聚焦稀土出口、核扩散以及与伊朗的战争，但华盛顿的两党人士正要求黄仁勋和卢特尼克就英伟达一事作出交代，两人都已被要求于12月在参议院银行委员会作证。

“If Beijing was trying to keep American chips flowing, it may have helped build the bipartisan case for cutting that access off,” Mr. Singleton said.

“如果北京当时试图让美国芯片继续流入，这一做法可能为两党切断该获取渠道的主张提供依据，”辛格尔顿说。

It remains to be seen if that political pressure will force Mr. Trump to impose new restrictions on technology exports, or make another move that could constrain China.

这种政治压力是否会迫使特朗普实施新的技术出口限制，或采取其他可能制约中国的举措，仍有待观察。

Kenton Thibaut, a senior resident China fellow at the Atlantic Council, said that the Nvidia scandal was a “miserable” scenario for the Chinese, whose diplomatic aim with Mr. Trump is to placate him and keep a competitive relationship steady while reducing dependence on the economic choke points that Americans control.

大西洋理事会驻会中国问题高级研究员肯顿·蒂博表示，英伟达丑闻对中方而言是一个“糟糕”的局面——中方对特朗普的外交目标是安抚他、保持竞争关系的稳定，同时减少对美国所控制的经济咽喉要道的依赖。

“They wanted to keep this stasis in U.S.-China relations, prevent sort of any more export controls from coming into place, play nice with Trump and not rock the boat in any way,” Ms. Thibaut said. “And this is kind of like a disaster for them.”

“他们原本希望维持美中关系的这种静止状态，防止出台更多出口管制措施，对特朗普保持友好，不以任何方式制造事端，”蒂博说。“而这件事对他们来说简直是一场灾难。”

Katie Rogers是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统相关新闻。

(Beijing has called the U.S. intelligence conclusions “smears and slanders.”)
黄仁勋的突然下台，以及美国关于他成为中国情报部门目标的调查结论，似乎并未改变特朗普对这位前英伟达领导人的评价——也未改变他在本周会晤中与中方领导人打交道的方式。（北京方面称美方情报结论是“污蔑抹黑”。）

So far, the president has not pressed Mr. Xi about his country’s espionage efforts or stepped in to resolve a raging debate within his administration about tightening export controls of A.I. technology and certain chips to China. Howard Lutnick, the commerce secretary, who has argued for less strict limits on chip exports to Asia, is expected to travel with him. In Shenzhen, Mr. Trump will participate in a meeting with Mr. Xi and, later, with Mr. Xi and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia, in the first such gathering of the three leaders.
迄今为止，总统尚未就中国的情报活动向习近平施压，也未介入平息政府内部关于收紧对华人工智能技术和特定芯片出口管制的激烈争论。一直主张放宽对亚洲芯片出口限制的商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克预计将随行。在深圳，特朗普将先与习近平举行会晤，随后还将与习近平及俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京共同会晤，这将是三位领导人的首次此类会晤。

“Well, the big thing is, was the woman a spy?” Mr. Trump said in an interview with the podcaster and sports commentator Stephen A. Smith on Thursday, when asked if he thought Mr. Huang should have resigned. “And I don’t know if that’s been determined yet, but if the woman was a spy, yes. If the woman was not a spy, perhaps it would be different. But I can tell you this: Somehow, he’ll end up in his feet. I mean, I know him. I know him pretty well. I always thought of him as a fine man.”
“嗯，关键问题是，那个女人是不是间谍？”特朗普周四在接受播客主持人、体育评论员斯蒂芬·A·史密斯采访时，被问及是否认为黄仁勋应该辞职时这样说道。“我还不知道这件事是否已有定论，但如果那个女人是间谍，那他确实应该辞职。如果那个女人不是间谍，情况也许会有所不同。但我可以告诉你：无论如何，他最终都会重新站稳脚跟的。我是说，我了解他。我相当了解他。我一直觉得他是个好人。”
Mr. Trump said last week that he did not plan to bring up the Nvidia matter with Mr. Xi but suggested that the Chinese leader could bring it up with him.
特朗普上周表示，他不打算向习近平提及英伟达一事，但表示这位中国领导人可能会向他提起此事。

The president also said that he did not recall being briefed that Mr. Huang was in a close relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese executive believed by the United States to be a Chinese intelligence asset.
总统还表示，他不记得曾听取过有关黄仁勋与黄乐关系密切的简报——后者是一名中国高管，被美方认为是中国情报线人。
黄仁勋与特朗普于2025年在白宫的合影。特朗普在周四谈到黄仁勋时说：“我一直觉得他是个好人。” Pete Marovich for The New York Times

But Secretary of State Marco Rubio told Mr. Trump aboard Air Force One in May en route to China about the sensitive intelligence showing that Nvidia’s chief executive was in a relationship with the woman and that she was believed to be a Chinese spy, The New York Times reported last week. It was at least the second time the president was briefed on the intelligence, The Times reported.
但据《纽约时报》上周报道，国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥5月在飞往中国的“空军一号”上就曾向特朗普通报过这份敏感情报，该情报显示，英伟达首席执行官与这位被认为是中国间谍的女子为情人关系。《纽约时报》报道称，这至少是总统第二次听取有关该情报的简报。
Mr. Trump has continued to defend Mr. Huang, calling him an “honorable man” and questioning reports that he was briefed on the government’s intelligence findings.
特朗普继续为黄仁勋辩护，称他是一个“正派的人”，并质疑有关自己曾听取政府情报调查结果简报的报道。

“I’d have to check,” he told reporters last week in response to a question about when he first learned of the matter. “I’d certainly check with the intelligence people. They could have been mentioned. Certainly, it didn’t make much of an impact on me.”
“我得核实一下，”他上周在回答有关何时首次得知此事的提问时对记者说。“我肯定会向情报人员核实。相关情况可能被提起过。但显然，这事没给我留下什么深刻印象。”

The president’s blasé response to espionage allegations that have upended one of the world’s largest companies belies the economic and political storm caused by the revelations of Mr. Huang’s behavior. It also raises questions about how Mr. Trump would conduct himself during his meeting with Mr. Xi, an authoritarian leader whose friendship and admiration the president has courted.
面对已使全球最大企业之一陷入动荡的间谍指控，总统漫不经心的回应与黄仁勋行为曝光所引发的经济与政治风暴形成了鲜明对比。这也让人质疑，特朗普在与习近平会晤时将如何表现——总统一直极力争取这位威权领导人的友谊与赞赏。

“Trump has stood by Huang personally, and my read is that he sees espionage as something major powers just do to each other,” Craig Singleton, a China expert at the Foundation for Defense of Democracies, a nonpartisan think tank, said during a briefing last week. “He wants a very successful meeting and to show that he can manage the relationship with Xi Jinping.”
“特朗普在个人层面上一直支持黄仁勋，我的解读是，他认为间谍活动不过是大国之间彼此都会做的事情，”无党派智库捍卫民主基金会的中国问题专家克雷格·辛格尔顿上周在一场简报会上表示。“他希望这次会晤非常成功，并展示自己能够把握好与习近平的关系。”

Indeed, Mr. Trump has said that espionage is the price of dealing with a powerful adversary. “You know what they say? That China spies on us. I say you’re right, and we spy on them, too,” he said in September.
事实上，特朗普曾表示，间谍活动是与强大对手打交道的代价。“你知道他们怎么说吗？他们说中国对我们搞间谍活动。我说你们说得对，但我们也对他们搞间谍活动，”他在9月说道。
White House officials said Friday that the Nvidia matter was a national security issue, and they did not expect the president to discuss it with Mr. Xi during their encounter.
白宫官员周五表示，英伟达一事属于国家安全问题，他们预计总统不会在会面期间与习近平讨论此事。
In his two previous meetings this year with the Chinese leader, Mr. Trump showed little interest in extracting concessions from China.
在今年此前与中国领导人的两次会晤中，特朗普几乎没有表现出争取中国让步的兴趣。

Mr. Trump struck a conciliatory tone with Mr. Xi during his visit to Beijing in May, emphasizing their personal relationship. And when Mr. Xi visited Washington in the fall, weeks after Mr. Trump decried what he claimed was meddling by Beijing in the 2020 election, the president leaned into the pageantry of the occasion. The state visit produced little in terms of policy announcements on matters of tension between the two countries — on A.I., trade or the war in Iran.
5月访问北京期间，特朗普对习近平采取了和解语调，强调两人的私人关系。秋季习近平访问华盛顿时——就在几周前特朗普还曾谴责他所称的北京对2020年大选的干预——总统却全心投入到盛大的礼宾仪式中。这次国事访问在两国存在分歧的议题上——包括人工智能、贸易或伊朗战争——几乎没有产生任何政策声明。
But as Mr. Trump prepares to head to China again, Mr. Singleton noted that “the politics back in Washington are moving in a very different direction.”
但就在特朗普准备再次前往中国之际，辛格尔顿指出，“华盛顿的政治风向正在朝截然不同的方向发展。”

The Trump administration is now facing questions and criticism over whether officials had properly policed the sale of chips to China. On Friday, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent publicly blamed the Commerce Department for failing to curb the sale of advanced Nvidia technology to the Singaporean firm Megaspeed, which employed Ms. Huang and built data centers that provide computing power to Chinese companies.
特朗普政府目前正因官员们是否妥善监管对华芯片销售而面临质疑和批评。周五，财政部长斯科特·贝森特公开指责商务部未能遏制向新加坡公司Megaspeed出售先进英伟达技术的行为——该公司曾雇用黄乐，并建设了向中国企业提供算力的数据中心。

“You will have to ask them about their internal processes,” he said of the Commerce Department, adding that his own agency had supported a stricter approach. “Treasury and my deputy has been pushing for this for months at the deputies level.”
“你们得去问问他们的内部流程，”他在谈及商务部时说，并补充称他所在的部门一直支持采取更严格的做法。“数月来，财政部和我的副手一直在副部级层面上推动此事。”

Mr. Bessent has led the administration’s efforts to extend a trade truce with Beijing that expires in January. Despite continuing negotiations and the pause of a tit-for-tat trade war, administration officials remain frustrated with China’s restrictions on exports of crucial rare-earth metals and rare-earth magnets. Mr. Trump is expected to bring up that issue with Mr. Xi in Shenzhen.
贝森特一直主导着政府与北京延长贸易休战期的努力，该休战期将于1月到期。尽管谈判仍在继续，且针锋相对的贸易战暂时休止，但政府官员仍对中国的关键稀土金属及磁体出口限制感到不满。预计特朗普将在深圳与习近平会晤时提及这一问题。

While administration officials say the president will focus his meetings on rare-earth exports, nuclear proliferation and the war with Iran, Republicans and Democrats in Washington are demanding answers on Nvidia from Mr. Huang and Mr. Lutnick, who both have been asked to testify before the Senate Banking Committee in December.
尽管政府官员表示总统将在会晤中聚焦稀土出口、核扩散以及与伊朗的战争，但华盛顿的两党人士正要求黄仁勋和卢特尼克就英伟达一事作出交代，两人都已被要求于12月在参议院银行委员会作证。
“If Beijing was trying to keep American chips flowing, it may have helped build the bipartisan case for cutting that access off,” Mr. Singleton said.
“如果北京当时试图让美国芯片继续流入，这一做法可能为两党切断该获取渠道的主张提供依据，”辛格尔顿说。
It remains to be seen if that political pressure will force Mr. Trump to impose new restrictions on technology exports, or make another move that could constrain China.
这种政治压力是否会迫使特朗普实施新的技术出口限制，或采取其他可能制约中国的举措，仍有待观察。

Kenton Thibaut, a senior resident China fellow at the Atlantic Council, said that the Nvidia scandal was a “miserable” scenario for the Chinese, whose diplomatic aim with Mr. Trump is to placate him and keep a competitive relationship steady while reducing dependence on the economic choke points that Americans control.
大西洋理事会驻会中国问题高级研究员肯顿·蒂博表示，英伟达丑闻对中方而言是一个“糟糕”的局面——中方对特朗普的外交目标是安抚他、保持竞争关系的稳定，同时减少对美国所控制的经济咽喉要道的依赖。

“They wanted to keep this stasis in U.S.-China relations, prevent sort of any more export controls from coming into place, play nice with Trump and not rock the boat in any way,” Ms. Thibaut said. “And this is kind of like a disaster for them.”
“他们原本希望维持美中关系的这种静止状态，防止出台更多出口管制措施，对特朗普保持友好，不以任何方式制造事端，”蒂博说。“而这件事对他们来说简直是一场灾难。”
Katie Rogers是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统相关新闻。

日本经产省拟与亚开行就支持亚洲各国引进核电签署备忘录

据了解，日本经济产业省计划与亚洲开发银行（ADB）签署合作备忘录，以推动亚洲各国引进核电站。目前，相关事宜正在协调之中。

计划前往菲律宾出席国际会议的日本经济产业大臣赤泽亮正，将于11月16日在菲律宾首都马尼拉与亚洲开发银行行长神田真人举行会谈。亚洲开发银行为亚洲地区的基础设施建设提供资金支持。

据了解，双方计划就携手推动亚洲各国引进核电站一事签署备忘录，目前正在进行协调。

菲律宾和越南等亚洲国家目前正在探讨建设核电站的计划。日本企业亦在推进研发的小型模块化反应堆（SMR），也被列为候选方案。

在此背景下，亚洲开发银行于2025年改变了以往不向核电项目提供资金的政策，使其能够为成员国引进核电提供支持。

经济产业省希望通过与亚洲开发银行开展合作，为亚洲各国引进核电站提供支持，从而推动日本企业进入未来有望扩大的亚洲核电市场。

items.body:
美国航班停飞措施解除后也有影响

在美国，11月13日由于通信故障的影响，美国全国各机场在大约四个半小时的时间里采取了所有航班全部停飞的措施，造成了严重混乱。14日，美国交通部长达菲和美国联邦航空管理局局长贝德福德召开新闻发布会，就最新情况进行了说明。

据两名官员介绍，这次事态造成的影响14日也在持续，预计有4000至5000个航班被取消。但他们也表示，航班取消和延误的情况正在逐步得到解决，预计15日航班将恢复正常。

另一方面，关于此次事态的原因，达菲解释说，在将陈旧通信设备的电路从铜线更换为光纤的过程中，系统负荷增大，导致通信陷入了不稳定状态。他表示为了确保安全采取了航班停飞措施，并要求公众对此予以理解。

此外，达菲表示将继续进行调查，不排除承包商工作人员在施工过程中出现人为失误或设备发生故障的可能性。

此外，达菲还表示，根据与联邦调查局和国防部等部门联合进行调查的结果，没有迹象显示存在网络攻击或来自外国的干预操纵。

美中“贸易理事会”召开首次会议讨论关税事宜

美国和中国11月13日以线上形式召开了“贸易理事会”的首次会议。该理事会是两国为探讨降低关税等问题而设立的。双方首脑计划借出席即将于深圳召开的亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议之机举行会谈，贸易谈判走向成为此次会谈的焦点之一。

今年5月，美国总统特朗普与中国国家主席习近平在北京举行了首脑会谈，双方同意设立“贸易理事会”，并就相互对300亿美元规模的商品降低关税达成一致。

据中国商务部14日公布的消息，双方13日以线上形式召开了“贸易理事会”的首次会议。

据悉，双方在会上就对等降低关税的举措以及农产品贸易等问题进行了建设性的交流，并确认将继续加强沟通。

此前，美中双方一度采取相互征收高额关税等措施，贸易摩擦不断加剧，但其后通过首脑会谈同意“休战”，原定于11月10日到期的期限被延长至明年1月10日。

items.body:
KATIE ROGERS2026年11月15日

特朗普总统将于本周在中国举行的峰会期间与中国领导人习近平和俄罗斯总统普京举行三方会晤。 Maxim Shemetov/Reuters

President Trump will have a joint meeting with Xi Jinping, China’s leader, and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia during a summit in China next week, a White House spokeswoman said on Friday.

白宫发言人周五表示，在中国本周举行的峰会期间，特朗普总统将与中国领导人习近平和俄罗斯总统普京举行三方会晤。

It will be the first trilateral meeting the three leaders have held together, and the third meeting Mr. Trump has had with Mr. Xi in person this year. At the meeting with Mr. Putin and Mr. Xi, Mr. Trump plans to discuss the war against Iran, but is not expected to bring up Russia’s war with Ukraine.

这将是三国领导人首次举行三方会晤，也是特朗普今年第三次与习近平举行面对面会谈。在与普京和习近平的会晤中，特朗普计划讨论针对伊朗的战争，但预计不会提及俄罗斯与乌克兰的战争。

Olivia Wales, the White House spokeswoman, said that Mr. Trump would also address the threat of nuclear proliferation. U.S. officials have expressed concerns about a steady buildup of China’s arsenal in recent years, and a U.S. nuclear arms control treaty with Russia expired in February.

白宫发言人奥利维亚·威尔斯表示，特朗普还将讨论核扩散威胁。近年来，中国的核武库持续扩张，引发美国官员担忧，而美俄之间的核军控条约已于今年2月到期。

“The president has made it clear that, among other topics, he will discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world, whose proliferation President Trump believes is very dangerous,” Ms. Wales said in a telephone briefing with reporters.

“总统已经明确表示，他将讨论包括全球核武器削减在内的多项议题。特朗普总统认为，核武器扩散非常危险，”威尔斯在与记者的电话吹风会上说。

Two senior administration officials, who spoke on the condition of anonymity to describe the president’s travel plans, said that Mr. Trump would travel to the Association of Southeast Asian Nations in Manila early next week. The officials said he would then travel to Shenzhen for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation, where he will meet with Mr. Xi and then both Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin.

两名政府高级官员称，特朗普本周初将前往马尼拉出席东盟峰会。这两名官员因介绍总统的行程安排而要求匿名。他们说，特朗普随后将前往深圳出席亚太经济合作组织会议，在那里先与习近平会面，然后再与习近平和普京举行三方会晤。

The officials said that Mr. Trump would be joined by the billionaire Elon Musk in Shenzhen, but added that Mr. Musk would not be part of the trilateral meeting.

这两名官员表示，亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克将随特朗普前往深圳，但不会参加三方会晤。

Mr. Trump is prepared to discuss the “difficult” topic of Beijing’s nuclear arsenal with Mr. Xi, one of the officials said.

其中一名官员表示，特朗普已准备好与习近平讨论中国核武库这一“棘手”议题。

China maintains secretive nuclear facilities and is on track to have 1,000 nuclear warheads by 2030, producing the weapons at a pace that has worried U.S. officials and analysts. On the call, the administration officials said that they did not expect any agreements on nuclear proliferation, and characterized the talks as a starting point.

中国的核设施高度保密，按照目前的发展趋势，到2030年，中国将拥有1000枚核弹头，生产速度已引起美国官员和分析人士的担忧。在电话吹风会上，政府官员表示，他们预计此次会谈不会就核扩散问题达成任何协议，并称这次会谈只是一个起点。

Mr. Trump said this week that he had no plans to discuss with Mr. Xi the scandal that had engulfed Jensen Huang, who until this week was the chief executive of Nvidia, one of the largest companies in the world. Mr. Huang stepped down from his role in the wake of revelations that he had engaged in extramarital affairs, including one with Alice Huang, a woman who U.S. intelligence officials believe is an asset of Beijing.

特朗普上周表示，他不打算与习近平讨论围绕黄仁勋的丑闻。黄仁勋此前一直担任全球最大企业之一英伟达的首席执行官，直至上周。黄仁勋因被曝出多段婚外情而辞职，其中一段婚外情的对象是黄乐(Alice Huang)。美国情报官员认为，黄乐是北京方面的情报人员。

The officials said that the matter involving Ms. Huang was a national security issue, and did not expect Mr. Trump to discuss it with Mr. Xi during a diplomatic meeting.

这些官员表示，涉及黄乐的事件属于国家安全问题，他们预计特朗普不会在与习近平的外交会晤中讨论此事。

Katie Rogers是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统相关新闻。

朝中社发文谴责日本拥核野心

朝中社15日发表评论文章，谴责日本政府打算在年内修改的安保文件中添加“紧急事态发生时允许运进核武器”的“例外情况”，表示日方这一企图是“实现其核野心的前奏”。

文章写道：“日本企图破坏战后国际秩序、改变地区力量平衡的新军国主义危险举动正向实现核野心发展。”日本此举是“依仗美国核武器实现军事野心，进而拥有核武器的危险意图的表现”。

文章说，当前日本国内批评现政权新军国主义动向的声音不断，本地区国家和国际社会也强烈谴责并反对日本修改核政策的企图。日本提出“例外情况”是“掩盖其阴险目的的骗术”，旨在平息国内外反对浪潮，逐步解禁并掏空“无核三原则”。

据日本共同社10日报道，一名日本政府高官当天谈及修订“安保三文件”时表示，有必要明确写入一种观点：作为“无核三原则”的例外情况，应允许在紧急情况下将核武器运进日本。

items.body:
海南大学运动会奖品有活鳄鱼

三轮车拉着黑猪黑山羊，扑腾着翅膀的鸡鸭在操场上列队……这不是农博会，而是大学生运动会的奖品，其中打头阵的竟然是两条鳄鱼。11月14日，海南大学（儋州校区）第53届田径运动会开幕，当奖品方阵的一车车动物出现在运动场上时，引起学生一阵欢呼。

学生拍摄的现场视频显示，一辆辆三轮车依次驶过主席台，打头阵的三轮车上竟然装着两条鳄鱼，鳄鱼的嘴和脚都被捆住，车的展示牌上写着，鳄鱼为这次运动会团体第一名和第二名的奖品。随后出现的三轮车上，有的装着黑猪，有的装着黑山羊，另外还有鸡鸭等动物。

在评论区，有网友表示，“海南大学的奖品太硬了！”还有网友表示，“万一得了第一名，领到鳄鱼怎么办啊？”

11月15日，海南大学（儋州校区）一工作人员告诉记者，本次运动会团体第一名将获奖一条鳄鱼、6只鸡和6只鸭，团体第二名可获奖一条鳄鱼、4只鸡和4只鸭，第三名奖品是一只黑猪和一只黑山羊，参赛的前8名都有动物作为奖励。

极目新闻记者了解，这次海南大学（儋州校区）运动会上的奖品都是由学校的校外合作基地提供，其中鳄鱼来自东方红草村鳄鱼产业园科技小院。11月15日，该产业园负责人许先生告诉极目新闻记者，他们主要是从事鳄鱼人工养殖，每年海南大学都有不少学生到产业园做鳄鱼研究，“我们人工养殖的鳄鱼，都是经批准许可且经正规检验检疫的，以食用为主。”许先生说。

许先生介绍，这次提供给学校作为奖品的两条鳄鱼，都是尼罗鳄的杂交品种，大概有40到50斤，每条价值1000多元。学生领到奖品后自己肯定无法喂养，最好是请食堂师傅帮忙处理后加餐。

资料显示，尼罗鳄是非洲体型最大的鳄鱼，成年雄性通常体长3.5米、体重近200公斤，最大个体体长可超过5.5米、体重接近1吨。尼罗鳄生性凶猛，成体能捕食羚羊、水牛、河马幼体等大型脊椎动物。

民进党新北市长参选人造势活动上意外撞断门牙

民进党新北市长参选人苏巧慧11月14日在造势活动时，意外撞断门牙，但仍在台上完成演唱。

据台湾《自由时报》等媒体报道，苏巧慧14日晚在新北市新庄区举办大型造势，她表演时意外发生碰撞造成牙齿断裂，但仍在台上忍痛将歌曲唱完才下台，并在休息后又戴着口罩上台。
苏巧慧随后在社媒Threads上发文称，在演唱歌曲时不小心弄断半根牙齿。不过，自己没有大碍，“大家不要担心”。

据报道，现场画面显示，苏巧慧在受撞击后门牙明显缺角，嘴角也带着血迹。

台湾“九合一”选举进入最后阶段，新北市是备受关注的选区之一。

SpaceX 完成了一项前所未有的壮举，在 Starship 航天器环绕地球近一整天后，在空中成功接住了这艘巨型飞船。

航天器在向其德克萨斯州发射场降落前，绕行地球完成了 14 圈，随后地面上方巨大的机械臂抓住了它。

APEC台湾参会代表称未安排与高市举行正式会谈

将代表台湾出席18日、19日在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）会议的施振荣13日向媒体透露说，没有与日本首相高市早苗举行正式会谈的安排。不过，他也表示应该有在会场交谈的机会。施振荣是电脑巨头宏碁（Acer）的创始人。

去年秋天在韩国召开APEC领导人会议之际，高市与代表台湾参会的林信义会谈了约25分钟。高市还在X（原推特）上发帖介绍了与林信义打招呼的情况。中国外交部则进行了批评。

施振荣还表示，以往在APEC领导人会议期间会有的台湾代表记者会今年或许无法召开。

日产汽车发布中国本土化研发生产的新车“NX7”

日产汽车13日在中国发布了插电式混合动力车（PHV）“NX7”，并于当天启动预售。这是一款面向年轻消费者的5座中型SUV。作为在中国研发生产的“N系列”新车，日产希望借此在持续低迷的当地市场实现反攻。

日产当天在广东省珠海市举行发布会，重点宣传该车在纯电模式下续航里程可达320公里等卖点。同时，该车还采用了中国新兴企业Momenta的最新驾驶辅助技术。起售价为12.99万元。这是日产到2027年在中国推出5款车计划的一部分，作为N系列的第4款车登场。

日产当天还正式宣布将在中国推出提升行驶性能的“NISMO”品牌。在华合资企业东风日产的总经理关口勋表示，包括跑车在内，“将全面动员（日产的技术）参与竞争。不会局限客户群，而是尽力满足各类需求。”

在中国市场，日产今年10月的销量同比大减67.1%，降至约2.2万辆。由于中国市场向PHV等新能源车转型的速度快于预期，日产受到较大冲击，因此已将原本设为315万辆的2026年度全球销量预期下调至297万至300万辆。

items.body:
日本男足3比2补时绝杀巴西

日本男足14日在新加坡的国际友谊赛中3比2战胜巴西队。这是双方自6月美加墨世界杯淘汰赛首轮交锋以来再次对决，世界杯赛场被巴西补时绝杀的日本队此番终于获胜。

日本队上半场凭借久保建英（皇家社会）和中村敬斗（里昂）的进球占据优势。此后，巴西队维尼修斯双响扳平了比分。下半场补时阶段，坂元达裕（考文垂）成功破门，帮助日本队取得戏剧性胜利。

10月7日公布的国际足联（FIFA）世界排名中，日本队位列第17，巴西队排名第6。两队交锋战绩改写为日本2胜2平12负。日本队在去年10月的国际友谊赛中首次战胜巴西队。

2018年起执教日本队逾八年的主教练森保一此次率日本队出征新加坡国际足球邀请赛。继14日后，17日对阵巴拉圭队的比赛将成为森保执教日本队的最后一战。
